<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <rect x="383" y="13" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#323232"/>

  <!-- Chat header -->
  <rect x="0" y="28" width="390" height="70" fill="#EBEBEB"/>

  <line x1="20" y1="63" x2="36" y2="63" stroke="#323232" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <text x="108" y="80" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Online now</text>
  <circle cx="330" cy="61" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="55" x2="330" y2="61" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <line x1="330" y1="61" x2="335" y2="64" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="362" cy="61" r="9" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <circle cx="362" cy="61" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="362" y1="52" x2="362" y2="49" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="356" y1="54" x2="354" y2="52" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="368" y1="54" x2="370" y2="52" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.4"/>

  <!-- Conversation area -->
  <rect x="0" y="98" width="390" height="654" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="157" y="115" width="76" height="24" rx="12" fill="#F4F4F4"/>
  <text x="195" y="131" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">TODAY</text>

  <!-- Incoming message 1 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="174" r="15" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="29" y="180" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">MS</text>
  <rect x="49" y="149" width="244" height="63" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  <text x="65" y="170" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Hi Jordan! How can I help</text>
  <text x="65" y="190" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">with your booking today?</text>
  <text x="263" y="202" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">10:02 AM</text>

  <!-- Outgoing message 1 -->
  <rect x="115" y="226" width="248" height="63" rx="16" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="132" y="247" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">I need to change my return</text>
  <text x="132" y="267" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">flight from Paris to London.</text>
  <text x="321" y="279" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#7A1851">10:04 AM</text>
  <polyline points="349,280 352,283 358,276" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Incoming message 2 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="332" r="15" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="29" y="338" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">MS</text>
  <rect x="49" y="305" width="283" height="72" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  <text x="65" y="326" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Of course. I found your booking</text>
  <text x="65" y="346" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">AF 2847 for 18 August.</text>
  <text x="65" y="366" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Paris → London · Economy</text>
  <text x="296" y="368" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">10:05 AM</text>

  <!-- Booking card -->
  <rect x="48" y="393" width="296" height="106" rx="14" fill="#000000" opacity="0.04"/>
  <rect x="48" y="391" width="296" height="106" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="48" y="391" width="5" height="106" rx="2" fill="#DB6186"/>
  <text x="67" y="415" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">BOOKING REFERENCE</text>
  <text x="67" y="440" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">AF 2847</text>
  <rect x="242" y="405" width="84" height="23" rx="11" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="284" y="420" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">CONFIRMED</text>
  <line x1="67" y1="451" x2="325" y2="451" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="67" y="473" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">18 Aug 2026</text>
  <text x="193" y="473" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">09:20 — 10:45</text>
  <text x="67" y="488" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Charles de Gaulle (CDG)</text>

  <!-- Incoming message 3 -->
  <circle cx="29" cy="536" r="15" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="29" y="542" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">MS</text>
  <rect x="49" y="514" width="262" height="56" rx="16" fill="#F2F2F2"/>
  <text x="65" y="537" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Your change fee is $45.00.</text>
  <text x="65" y="556" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Shall I proceed?</text>
  <text x="274" y="562" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">10:06 AM</text>

  <!-- Outgoing message 2 -->
  <rect x="126" y="587" width="237" height="57" rx="16" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="143" y="610" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Yes, please proceed.</text>
  <text x="143" y="630" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#323232">Thank you!</text>
  <text x="322" y="635" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#7A1851">10:07 AM</text>
  <polyline points="342,635 345,638 351,631" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <!-- Composer -->
  <rect x="0" y="700" width="390" height="52" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="700" x2="374" y2="700" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="31" cy="726" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.7"/>
  <line x1="31" y1="720" x2="31" y2="732" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="25" y1="726" x2="37" y2="726" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="52" y="709" width="255" height="35" rx="17" fill="#F4F4F4"/>
  <text x="70" y="731" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#A8A8AC">Write a message...</text>
  <circle cx="330" cy="726" r="19" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <polyline points="322,726 337,719 333,735 328,729 322,726" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="729" x2="337" y2="719" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="752" width="390" height="92" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="752" x2="390" y2="752" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>

    <circle cx="197" cy="779" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="202" cy="779" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="196" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <!-- Account -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="324" cy="776" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="324" cy="790" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="324" y="811" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto, sans-serif" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Account</text>
  </g>
